title: 第19章 双生灵兽第20章 药园相争
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
烤鸡一拿出来，任生平就被香味吸引住了，也没有跟楚少野客气，一边吃一边道：“其实也没啥，就人跟人之间那一点儿事呗。”
“方管事和汪管事实力差不多，汪管事稍微逊色一些，咱宗门里有规定，实力达到五阶就可以申请长老之位。”
“咱们住的这个峰叫做录芒峰，目前只有一个长老空位，这不就争上了嘛。”
“咱们这个宿舍区是方管事管着的，靠山脚的那个是汪管事管着的，上边的人不和，下边的人也不睦，你没事别去那边溜达，小心被他们欺负了。”
楚少野点点头，又给他添了一杯水，“任兄能不能跟我说说宗门内的情况，我初来乍到，什么都是两眼一抹黑。”
“这有什么不能的，”
任生平道，“从最上头开始说吧，咱们赤霄宗的宗主你应该听说过，云鼎真人，六阶灵主，本命灵宠是六阶烈鹰，最近宗主正在闭关，据说是在冲击七阶。”
“如果宗主能够成功进阶，成为七阶高级灵主，那咱们赤霄宗以后可就厉害了。”
楚少野点点头，万灵大陆上的灵主共分九阶，一到三阶为初阶灵主，四到六阶为中级灵主，七到九阶为高阶灵主。
其中每个大阶段之间的跨越都犹如鸿沟，一但跨过去，那实力就不是能够同日而语的了。
任生平继续道：“如今宗主闭关，目前咱们宗门由两位代宗主暂管，两位代宗主是云鼎真人的双胞胎女儿，名为青姬和红姬，她们的本命灵兽也是双生的。”
“双生本命灵兽？”
楚少野惊讶道，“这还是我第一次听说。”
任生平感慨道：“谁不是呢，两位代宗主的本命灵兽叫灵犀比翼鸟，一为青鸟，一为红鸾，双飞比翼，心有灵犀。”
“灵犀比翼鸟单只只有五阶的实力，但是合起来却堪比六阶的灵兽，这也是为什么宗主能够放心去闭关的原因。”
楚少野听的很认真，霜月教他认识了很多灵兽，但却从来没说过有双生灵兽，果然世界之大无奇不有，他还要多走多看。
“自代宗主之下，还有十二位长老，每位长老手下又有数位管事，人数太多，我就不一一介绍了。”
“而我们这些弟子人数就更多了，赤霄宗的弟子分为三类，一是内门弟子，他们都有亲传师父，待遇也最好，二是外门弟子，大多没有亲传师父，只能上宗门内的大课。”
“至于我们这些杂役弟子，说弟子是好听的，其实就是赤霄宗雇来干活的，那些内门外门的弟子，虽然嘴上不说，但心里压根儿瞧不上咱们，把咱们当下人看待。”
任生平说到这儿叹了口气，“天赋不如人，没奈何啊。”

楚少野点了点头，心里却不这么认为，天赋固然重要，但努力也是不可或缺的，他问道：“那我们可以去听大课吗？”
任生平点点头，“可以是可以，但是一整天都要干活，哪儿还有时间和精力去上课，去了也是遭人白眼。”
两人又谈论了一些事，天色不知不觉间彻底黑了下来，烤野鸡也吃的一干二净。
任生平有些不好意思，“楚兄弟，你看这鸡几乎都是我吃的，你都没吃多少。”
楚少野摇摇头示意没事，将吃剩的鸡骨收了起来，拿去外面丢了。
content_en:
As soon as the roast chicken was taken out, Ren Shengsheng was attracted by the smell. He was not polite to Chu Shaoye and said while eating: "Actually, it's nothing, it's just a matter between people."
"Steward Fang and Steward Wang are about the same strength. Steward Wang is slightly inferior. There are regulations in our sect that you can apply for the position of elder if your strength reaches level five."
"The peak we live in is called Lumang Peak. Currently, there is only one vacancy for the elder, so we have to fight for it."
"Our dormitory area is in charge of Manager Fang, and the one at the foot of the mountain is in charge of Manager Wang. The people above are not getting along, and the people below are not getting along either. Don't go there for a walk if you have nothing to do, or you will be bullied by them."
Chu Shaoye nodded and gave him another glass of water, "Brother Ren, can you tell me about the situation in the sect? I'm a newbie here, and everything is dark."
"What's wrong with this?"
Ren Shengping said, "Let's start from the top. You should have heard of the sect master of our Scarlet Sky Sect. Master Yunding is the sixth-level spiritual master. His natal spiritual pet is the sixth-level blazing eagle. Recently, the sect master is in retreat. It is said that he is attacking the seventh level."
"If the sect leader can successfully advance and become a seventh-level senior spiritual master, then our Chixiao Sect will be very powerful in the future."
Chu Shaoye nodded. There are nine levels of spirit masters in Wanling Continent. Levels one to three are primary spirit masters, levels four to six are intermediate spirit masters, and levels seven to nine are high-level spirit masters.
The crossing between each major stage is like a chasm. Once crossed, the strength will no longer be the same.
Ren Shengping continued: "Now that the sect master is in retreat, our sect is currently under the temporary supervision of two acting sect masters. The two acting sect masters are the twin daughters of Master Yunding, named Qingji and Hongji. Their natal spiritual beasts are also twins."
"Twin natal spiritual beasts?"
Chu Shaoye said in surprise, "This is the first time I've heard of it."
Ren Shengping said with emotion: "Who wouldn't be? The natal spiritual animals of the two acting sect leaders are called rhinoceros birds. One is a blue bird and the other is a red luan. They fly together and have a clear understanding of each other."
"The Spirit Rhinoceros Birds alone are only as strong as the fifth level, but together they are comparable to the sixth level spiritual beasts. This is why the sect master can go into seclusion with confidence."
Chu Shaoye listened very seriously. Shuangyue taught him a lot of spiritual beasts, but he never said that there were twin spiritual beasts. As expected, the world is full of wonders, and he still wants to walk more and see more.
"Under the acting sect leader, there are twelve elders, and each elder has several stewards. There are too many people, so I won't introduce them one by one."
"There are even more disciples like us. The disciples of Scarlet Sky Sect are divided into three categories. One is the inner disciples. They all have personal masters and receive the best treatment. The second is the outer disciples. Most of them do not have personal masters and can only attend major classes within the sect."
"As for us handyman disciples, we are called disciples, but we are actually hired by the Scarlet Sky Sect to do the work. Although those disciples from the inner and outer sects don't say it with their mouths, they don't look down on us at all in their hearts and treat us as human beings."
When Ren Shengping said this, he sighed, "The talent is not as good as others, so there is nothing you can do."
Chu Shaoye nodded, but he didn't think so in his heart. Talent is important, but hard work is also indispensable. He asked: "Then can we go to the big class?"
Ren Shengping nodded, "Yes, yes, but you have to work all day long. How can you still have time and energy to go to class? If you go, you will be looked down upon."
The two talked about some more things, and the sky turned completely dark before they knew it, and the roasted pheasant was completely eaten.
Ren Shengsheng was a little embarrassed, "Brother Chu, look, I ate almost all of this chicken, and you didn't eat much."
Chu Shaoye shook his head to indicate that it was okay, collected the leftover chicken bones, and threw them outside.
